import torch


class OptimizerModule:
    """Base class for composable optimizer modules.

    Each instance keeps its own per-parameter state dictionary, so composed
    modules never share buffers.  The composition of modules is therefore a
    plain function composition and stays associative:
        ((A o B) o C)(p) == (A o (B o C))(p)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        # Per-instance state.  Never class-level: a class attribute would make
        # every instance (and every composed copy) share the same buffers.
        self.state = {}

    def update(self, p: torch.Tensor, grad: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def __call__(self, p: torch.Tensor, grad: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        return self.update(p, grad)


class Compose(OptimizerModule):
    """Left-to-right composition of optimizer modules.

    ``Compose(a, b)(p, g)`` applies ``a`` first, then ``b`` to the result of
    ``a``.  Composition is associative because it only threads the output of
    one module into the next one; no shared mutable state is involved.
    """
